note: The Credit Reporting Act (No. 5 of 2023), section 28(2), as the Central Bank of Belize publishes it: a bureau may not disclose negative information more than two years after the credit's termination or settlement. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Central Bank of Belize, Credit Reporting Act, No. 5 of 2023
sources.said: if a credit bureau obtains negative information regarding credit extended to or in respect of a consumer, the credit bureau shall not disclose such information for a period longer than two years after the date of termination or settlement of such credit.
